about_the_game:
In My Hooptie! you’re a determined driver stuck with a rusty car and a tight budget in the year 2002. Your goal? Fix your car, make some cash, and survive the daily grind however you can.

Start by rebuilding your car from parts scattered all over your garage. Build up the  engine and add performance or style parts to make it your own whether that’s a practical ride or a flashy street machine. Then take it out for races or just drive around the map.

Life isn’t easy, though. You’ll need to find food, water, and rest to keep going. Work various jobs like selling wood, potatoes, or mining for ores or find scrap to sell at the pawnshop.

Whether you want to race hard or live off the land, the choice is yours. Manage your time, money, and car, and build your story set in 2002.

Features:

  • Car and engine assembly from individual parts

  • Various vehicles, cars and a moped available to drive.

  • Upgrade and tune your car for performance or aesthetics

  • Relax at home by playing a handheld retro console or watching TV

  • A blend of survival, mechanical sim gameplay

  • Multiple jobs like selling wood or cave mining for ores to help cover food, drinks, and fuel costs.

  • Map with several distinct places and areas full of hidden secrets

  • And more!!!
